strategy_description: Hold SPY when the lagged U. Michigan Consumer Sentiment signal is favorable (optimism); else cash.
lead_description: Signal is lagged 1 month(s) before allocation.
notes: Rising consumer sentiment precedes stronger spending and risk-on equity conditions. The bounded headline-sentiment level is stationary. Winner (level) is selected by in-sample Sharpe on the common IS window (1997-12-31 to 2018-03-31) over a floored lead grid [1..13] and evaluated on the held-out OOS window; still a search-selected rule, not validated. NEW pair; compare with umcsent_xlv (same series vs XLV) and umcsent_spy (expected-business-conditions diffusion vs SPY).

selection.objective_formula: in-sample (common window [common_is_start, OOS start)) monthly mean/std*sqrt(12); winner evaluated on OOS window

is_window.rule: common_is_start = latest first-valid-return date across all grid candidates; IS metrics for every candidate computed on [common_is_start, oos_start)

selection.rationale: Winner is the IS-valid row with the highest IN-SAMPLE Sharpe (common IS window) over the published floored grid; OOS metrics are reported for that row only (no OOS look-ahead in selection).

legacy_oos_selected_row.note: Pre-GH#251 OOS-argmax selection, comparison only; see legacy_oos_selection_20261015.csv

sensitivity_own_is_start_row.note: IS argmax without common-start alignment; sensitivity only
